$description: The widths the client actually branches on. `2xl` (1536px) is absent because nothing uses it, and 480px is present because the phone round is load-bearing: the graph is ABSENT on a phone by construction, so narrow is a different layout and not a squeezed one.

xs.$description: 30rem - the collapsed header. Below this the product is a report, not a board.

sm.$description: 40rem - also Tailwind's `sm:`, the client's most-used prefix

md.$description: 48rem - the footer goes to two columns

xl.$description: 80rem - the column cap comes OFF; above this the app is uncapped, not centred wider

container.$description: One measure for the whole page: the app column, the static intro and the footer all match `main`'s box, because a column that does not line up with the app above it reads as a different site.

app.$description: 64rem, Tailwind `max-w-5xl`; uncapped above the xl breakpoint

gutter.$description: 2rem, the page's own padding, held at every width

test-width.$description: The width narrow-layout work is proved at. Not a breakpoint - a measurement target.
